q1_issues.issue: (Past sk_impart_1) tenses a participial reduced relative ("imparted by Nicklaus"), but tense atoms are licensed on finite clauses only and a participial reduced relative tenses nothing.
(Past sk_buoy_1) likewise tenses the free participial adjunct "Buoyed by …", which carries no tense atom of its own.
(Member sk_score_1 score) types the referent of "an 8-under 64" with a kind word no part of the sentence supplies.
(Measure sk_score_1 score 64 stroke) invents both the scale and the unit, where the instruction set reserves the symbol `unspecified` for a slot no word supplies.
The qualifier "8-under" is silently dropped rather than carried or left out with the gap recorded.

q2_gaps: A par-relative score nominal ("an 8-under 64"): a bare numeral used as a noun plus a relative-to-baseline modifier, with no stated scale or unit — no encoding is defined for the baseline-relative part.
A free participial adjunct linked to the matrix clause by nothing but juxtaposition ("Buoyed by X, Howell shot …"): the circumstantial/causal relation it states has no licensed connective carrier.
notes: The mass partitive "some of the advice" (Member/PartOf/ProportionOf, no GroupOf) and the passive by-phrase taking Agent both follow the instruction set correctly. The substantive losses are the two participial tense atoms and the invented score scale/unit.
